title: Professional academy workspace verified
summary: Verified the resumed course redesign, focused course sections, responsive layouts and navigation in the local web app.

changes.detail: Corrected a JSX closing tag and non-tuple title spread identified during type checking.
Repeatable browser smoke checks using disposable progress and intercepted synthetic authentication, with screenshots for the overview, lessons and workshop.
Completed verification of the prior unfinished course-professional-redesign-1791727656966 header, next-lesson action and progress filters.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck and ESLint for CourseOverview, CourseLessonList, CourseWorkspace and app/course/[id].tsx passed after corrections.

validation.name: Course and history tests
validation.detail: 11 tests passed: course-flow, course-workshops, change-history and change-history-interaction, including stored progress, workshop drafts and history persistence.

validation.name: Browser interactions and responsive layout
validation.detail: 24 checks: Arabic, English and French; light and dark themes; widths 320, 390, 768 and 1280. Section navigation and workshop expansion preserved in all language/theme combinations. English checks also verified progress filters, search preservation and start-course navigation. No page errors. Initial harness authentication and French label failures were corrected before the passing run.

validation.name: Visual inspection
validation.detail: Reviewed Arabic mobile overview, lessons and expanded practice screenshots plus English dark overview. No clipping seen in reviewed screenshots.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No production deployment, Android/iOS device test or live authentication/backend validation. Browser authentication was intercepted with synthetic data. Other course-specific content was not visually reviewed.

preview.label: Current academy course (local web verified; not a historical snapshot)
